description.value: Methods for determining which version of a resource a canonical reference that does not specify a version should resolve to.

definition.value: Resolve the reference using the package dependencies of the package that contains the referencing resource: select the most recent version of the referenced resource found within that package and its transitive dependencies. This is the default behavior when no resolution method is specified.

Resolve the reference using a manifest that is expected to be provided by the context of use. Resolving the reference in the absence of a manifest is an error. This code does not define the manifest itself.
Resolve the reference to the latest version that is available, independent of package dependencies or manifests, however resources are made available (for example, through terminology services).
